Ganesh idol processions planned for Anant Chaturdashi in Indore

Authorities in Indore have made arrangements for Ganesh idol processions on Anant Chaturdashi. The Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) inspected immersion sites, and police and home guard personnel will be deployed. Traffic plans include closing entry to procession routes from the afternoon and diversions for heavy vehicles. Cameras will monitor for disturbances during the processions, with action to be taken against those causing trouble.
